description.value: L'Apéro Wine & Cheese Bistro is a French-inspired wine and cheese restaurant in downtown Victoria built around the French apéro tradition of drinks, small plates, and convivial evenings. Founded by Guillaume, a Lyon-raised cheesemonger, the bistro serves lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch centered on artisan cheeses, charcuterie, raclette, and French bistro classics. The in-store and online shop sells ready-made cheese and charcuterie boards billed as perfect for a picnic, making it a tempting resupply stop for touring cyclists.
